key_highlights: ASX set to open higher tracking Wall Street's tech-led rally following Jensen Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia.
Severe domestic macro headwinds emerge as Australian flash PMI plunges into contractionary/recessionary territory.
Heavy speculative shorting against AUD/USD reaches record levels amid mounting global and domestic growth concerns.
Mining sector shows sharp divergence: Chinese property slump threatens bulk iron ore, while gold and critical minerals exploration gains momentum.
Banking and credit sectors face scrutiny over household mortgage stress and calls for APRA serviceability buffer reform.

sectors.trend: Bulk iron ore pressured by deepening Chinese real estate downturn; strong exploration results and development activity across WA and SA gold and copper.
sectors.implications: Underweight iron ore pure-plays (FMG.AX); accumulate defensive gold producers (NST.AX, EVN.AX) and critical mineral developers.

sectors.trend: High mortgage burden impacts household balance sheets, driving debate on APRA buffer adjustments and loan serviceability.
sectors.implications: Margins under pressure as credit growth slows and bad debt risks tick up; cautious near-term view on major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX).

sectors.trend: Strong sentiment rebound driven by US mega-cap tech recovery, counterbalanced by infrastructure bottlenecks around data centre power consumption.
sectors.implications: Tactical trading bounce for ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX); scrutinise power supply agreements for data centre operators (NXT.AX).

sectors.trend: Persistent domestic gas supply constraints and rising power demand from AI and data centres challenge emission targets.
sectors.implications: Wholesale energy prices remain elevated, supporting domestic producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX, ORG.AX) despite policy scrutiny.

sectors.trend: Demographic cross-subsidisation debates in private health insurance alongside rising demand for mental health screening.
sectors.implications: Regulatory friction threatens private health insurer margins (MPL.AX, NHF.AX); defensive stability in primary healthcare (CSL.AX).

sectors.trend: Anticipated rebound of Chinese inbound tourism in 2027 provides a potential medium-term offset to weak domestic retail sentiment.
sectors.implications: Positive medium-term outlook for travel and aviation (QAN.AX, FLT.AX), while domestic discretionary retail faces macro pressure.

key_themes: Offshore tech relief versus domestic macro contraction.
Commodity divergence: Bulk iron ore headwinds vs. gold and critical mineral resilience.
Household debt stress and macroprudential regulation pressure.
Currency vulnerability amid aggressive AUD short positioning.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive, cash-generative equities (healthcare, consumer staples) and high-quality liquid assets.
Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore producers; rotate into precious metals and diversified base metals.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Currency Devaluation and Speculative Short Squeeze
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain exposure to offshore USD earners (CSL.AX, AMC.AX) to hedge AUD downside.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy Grid and Gas Supply Deficits
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritise energy producers with uncontracted spot gas exposure and contracted power generation infrastructure.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate gold and copper producers as macro hedges and exploration beneficiaries.
opportunities.rationale: Gold offers safe-haven protection against domestic recession risks while active discoveries expand resource bases.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight high-quality USD-earning healthcare and global tech leaders.
opportunities.rationale: Leverages Wall Street's tech bounce and provides insulation from weak domestic PMI and falling AUD.

opportunities.recommendation: Build positions in travel and aviation ahead of Chinese tourist return.
opportunities.rationale: Expected recovery of high-yielding Chinese inbound tourism in 2027 offers secular growth isolated from domestic retail slowdown.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to major domestic banks and mortgage-sensitive lenders.
defensive_moves.rationale: Deteriorating flash PMI and mounting household mortgage stress constrain credit expansion and elevate loan impairment risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad ASX 200 exposure against China property contagion and macro slowdown.
defensive_moves.rationale: Deepening Chinese real estate slump poses downside risk to bulk miners and broader index earnings.

market_outlook.short_term: 1–3 month ASX outlook: Range-bound and volatile. Morning relief rally spurred by US tech rebound faces strong resistance from flash PMI contraction and AUD weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month medium-term outlook: Cautious. Subdued domestic demand and Chinese property distress will weigh on cyclical corporate earnings, increasing pressure on the RBA to consider rate cuts.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and updated monetary policy guidance
Official Australian Q3/Q4 GDP and CPI inflation prints following flash PMI slump
Chinese fiscal and real estate sector stabilization measures
APRA review of mortgage serviceability buffer settings
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate movements and speculative short interest
Dalian Commodity Exchange iron ore futures and spot prices
Australian bank mortgage delinquency and 90+ day arrears rates
Global tech sector sentiment and US semiconductor bellwether guidance
